'''Law and crime'''
*[[Leongatha mushroom murders]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Victoria#Court of Appeal|Court of Appeal]] of [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], rejects [[Erin Patterson]]'s appeal against her [[Murder in Australian law|murder]] convictions and removes her 33-year [[parole]] eligibility, effectively imposing [[Life imprisonment in Australia|life imprisonment without parole]] for killing three relatives with [[Amanita phalloides|death cap mushrooms]] in 2023. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Polish constitutional crisis]]
**[[Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis (2015 – ongoing)|Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis]]
***[[Suspension of Bogdan Święczkowski]]
****[[Poland|Polish]] [[Police of Poland|police]] enter the [[Constitutional Tribunal (Poland)|Constitutional Tribunal]] following the suspension of its president [[Bogdan Święczkowski]], announced by judge [[Anna Korwin-Piotrowska]]. The tribunal describes the suspension as a [[coup d'état]], while three protesters in support of [[Law and Justice|PiS]] are detained after breaching the tribunal's fence. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/30/polish-president-turns-back-mid-flight-amid-coup-detat-allegations (Euronews)]
****[[Ministry of Justice (Poland)|Polish justice minister]] [[Waldemar Żurek]] requests stripping the tribunal's president and vice president [[Bartłomiej Sochański]] of their immunity from prosecution in order to charge them. [[President of Poland|President]] [[Karol Nawrocki]] cancels [[List of international presidential trips made by Karol Nawrocki|his trip]] to [[Senegal]] due to the situation and lands back in Poland. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-european-union-justice-protests-police-tribunal-67eda2e3a151e00038d85a5e894a2a72 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crz9824d5e88o (BBC News)]
